criterion: a demo login reaches only demo data
a real user can't use the password route
a blocked side effect returns an error for a demo session
a demo session can't create an invite
data a demo session changes is still there at the next demo login
after the demo account is deleted, the next demo login recreates it from the snapshot
the snapshot equals the factory's output for the fixed seed
many failed logins throttle that IP but don't block a correct login from another IP
DEMO_PASSWORD_HASH is checked with Argon2id in constant time, and a wrong password returns 401 without saying whether the username exists
